decision_conditions:
Commencement of development (Full Permission) - The development to which this permission relates shall be commenced not later than the expiration of 3 years from the date of this permission.

Reason:  To comply with Section 91 (as amended) of the Town & Country Planning Act 1990.

<p style="text-align: justify; "><span style="font-size:12.0pt;line-height:107%;

Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development)(England) Order 2015
(or any order revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without
modification) no enlargement, window, door or other opening other than those expressly
authorised by this permission shall be constructed in (officer to insert
relevant elevations) without planning permission first being obtained from the
Local Planning Authority.</span></span></p><p style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-size:12.0pt;line-height:107%;
font-family:" arial",sans-serif;mso-fareast-font-family:aptos;mso-fareast-theme-font:="" minor-latin;mso-ansi-language:en-gb;mso-fareast-language:en-us;mso-bidi-language:="" ar-sa"=""><span style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 107%;"><u><span style="font-size: 14px;">Reason</span></u><span style="font-size: 14px;">:&nbsp; To safeguard the

the following Development Plan policies for Merton: policy D4 of the London
Plan 2021 and policies D12.3 &amp; D12.4</span></span><span style="font-size: 14px; line-height: 107%;" aptos",sans-serif;mso-ascii-theme-font:minor-latin;="" mso-fareast-font-family:aptos;mso-fareast-theme-font:minor-latin;mso-hansi-theme-font:="" minor-latin;mso-bidi-font-family:"times="" new="" roman";mso-bidi-theme-font:minor-bidi;="" mso-ansi-language:en-gb;mso-fareast-language:en-us;mso-bidi-language:ar-sa"="">&nbsp;</span><span style="font-size: 14px; line-height: 107%;">of the Local Plan 2024.&nbsp;&nbsp;</span></span></p>

External Lighting - Any external lighting shall be positioned and angled to prevent any light spillage or glare beyond the site boundary.

Reason:  To safeguard the amenities of the area and the occupiers of neighbouring properties and ensure compliance with the following Development Plan policies for Merton: policies D12.1 & D12.3 of the Local Plan 2024.

<p style="text-align: justify; "><span style="font-size: 14px;">﻿</span><span style="font-size: 14px; line-height: 107%; font-family: Arial, sans-serif;"><u><span style="font-size: 14px;"><span style="font-size: 14px;">R</span><span style="font-size: 14px;">estriction - Use of Premises</span></span></u><span style="font-size: 14px;"> - The premises shall only be used for no other purpose (</span></span><span style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 14px;">including any other purpose within Class E of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes Order) 1997)</span><span style="line-height: 107%; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 14px;">&nbsp;other than Class</span><span style="line-height: 107%; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 14px;">&nbsp;</span><strong style="border-width: 0px; border-style: solid; overflow-wrap: break-word; font-family: &quot;Open Sans&quot;, HelveticaNeue, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;"><span style="font-size: 14px;">E(g)(i) (</span></strong><span style="font-family: &quot;Open Sans&quot;, HelveticaNeue, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 14px;"><span style="font-size: 14px;">Offices to carry out any operational or administrative function).</span><span style="font-size: 14px;">&nbsp;</span></span></p><p style="text-align: justify; "><u>Reason</u>:&nbsp; The Local Planning Authority would wish to
retain control over any further change of use of these premises in the
interests of safeguarding the amenities of the area and to ensure compliance
with the following Development Plan policies for Merton: policy D4 of the
London Plan 2021 and policies D12.1 &amp; D12.3 of the Local Plan 2024.</p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify; "><span style="font-size:12.0pt;line-height:107%;font-family:
" arial",sans-serif"=""><u><span style="font-size: 14px;">Boundary Treatment</span></u><span style="font-size: 14px;"> - The development shall not be occupied until any existing boundary fencing which is damaged or in a poor state of repair is replaced and installed prior to first occupation.&nbsp;&nbsp;</span></span></p><p style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-size:12.0pt;line-height:107%;font-family:" arial",sans-serif;="" mso-fareast-font-family:aptos;mso-fareast-theme-font:minor-latin;mso-ansi-language:="" en-gb;mso-fareast-language:en-us;mso-bidi-language:ar-sa"=""><span style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 107%;"><u><span style="font-size: 14px;">Reason</span></u><span style="font-size: 14px;">: To ensure a satisfactory and safe development in accordance with
